purpose: Teach: クイーン/神戸大学/日本テレビ/ヤマハ/セルビア/養老/慶應義塾/中国共産党

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、クイーンの音楽がお好きだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, your customer loves Queen's music.
lines.style: Soft, almost wondering tone. Sharing a small observation like passing a thought across a table. Gentle cadence, no judgment. Slight upward lilt at the end — inviting Aoi to add her own piece.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、神戸大学の同窓会に行かれたって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Your customer went to a Kobe University alumni gathering, Mei mentioned.
lines.style: Quiet, conversational. Settling into the rhythm of exchange. Warm interest — not probing, just noticing what Mei noticed. Breath comes easily, pace is natural.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、日本テレビの番組に出演されたって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Your customer appeared on a Nippon Television program.
lines.style: Slight surprise softens into respect. The cadence lifts a little — this is a more impressive detail. Still gentle, still wondering. A pause before the period, letting it land.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ヤマハのピアノを弾かれるって、メイちゃん
lines.style: Even quieter now. Reverent almost — a skill, an accomplishment. Slow pace. The words take on weight. No rush to the end.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、セルビアに親族がいらっしゃるって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Your customer has relatives in Serbia.
lines.style: Interest sharpens slightly — this is a detail that opens a world. Clearer articulation, but still tender. Thoughtful space between syllables. Wonder in the voice.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、養老の滝に行かれたって、メイちゃん
lines.style: Wistful, almost envious in the gentlest way. The kind of thing you say when you're imagining the place. Soft breathing. A slight trailing quality — like she's picturing it as she speaks.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、慶應義塾大学のOBだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Your customer is an alumnus of Keio University.
lines.style: Another layer building. Recognition in the tone — this is someone with depth, with presence. Steady but not cold. Still matching Mei's rhythm of quiet sharing.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、中国共産党の動向に詳しいって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Your customer is quite knowledgeable about Chinese Communist Party developments.
lines.style: Slight pause before the last clause. Raised eyebrows in the voice — this is an unexpected detail, almost amusing in its specificity. Still warm, still wondering. Close and intimate, like this is something just between them.
